# Independent audit of the actual one-ear and symmetric quadrilateral source

Audited source:
`candidate 11020364891cd885`.

Result: PASS, with no repair required. This audit does not extend the
source to asymmetric ears or arbitrary convex bodies.

1. For the general ear, its negative part at P_3 has exactly the two
   edge fractions w/(w+p) and w/(w+v), proving the removed-area fraction
   w^2/[(w+p)(w+v)]. Differentiating that triangle area at the cut level
   gives the positive added coarea chord 2Ew/[(w+p)(w+v)]. Its intersection
   with the old section is only their common-edge point. Thus the chord
   measures add, and the displayed virtual-height correction has the
   stated positive sign and coefficient v(1+p/w).

2. The determinant-one shear in Section 2 sends the four prescribed
   vertices to endpoints of two crossing axis segments. For delta>0
   their convexity and cyclic order are strict; at delta=0 the fourth
   point is on the old edge. Zero is interior for all the stated positive
   parameters. The source's reflection interchanges the last two caps
   and preserves the first, so equality of their areas and coarea chords
   is actual geometric symmetry, not an imposed scalar constraint.

3. The cap-1 chord is the original triangle's vertical chord at zero,
   of length 2v(x+2u)/(x+2v). Its cap area is v times that chord. The
   other cap and chord formulas agree with the general ear computation.
   The normalization H=v+H_2 is half the sum of all three virtual heights;
   hence f_i=2sqrt(kQ_i)/(sigma_i H) agrees with the generalized vector
   formed from actual q_i/sigma_i. There is no factor-of-two loss.

4. All denominators in the rational identity (7) are positive. Its right
   side is nonnegative and strictly positive for delta>0 because every
   coefficient of P is positive. Substituting the actual f formulas and
   sqrt(L(L+delta))<=L+delta/2 proves the selected inequality. For the
   remaining two, r+s^2<=2 and
   4[2-s-(2-s^2+s)^2/4]=(4-s^2)(s-1)^2>=0 are sufficient. The first
   comparison remains strict when delta>0, including at s=1.

Reran `supporting computation verify_one_ear_symmetric_lorentz_slab_recovery.py` independently:
4,380 exact actual-polygon and deficit checks PASS. These checks supplement
the full symbolic and geometric proof; they are not evidence for any
unstated family.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
